title: Sony says GTA VI is the biggest launch in PlayStation history across five generations, with 39M+ unique PS5 players logging 683M hours from November 19 to 22 (Tim Turi/PlayStation.Blog)
summary: Tim Turi / PlayStation.Blog: Sony says GTA VI is the biggest launch in PlayStation history across five generations, with 39M+ unique PS5 players logging 683M hours from November 19 to 22 — Celebrating the PlayStation community and Rockstar Games for creating an incredible moment in gaming and entertainment.
